$comment: Nov. 6, 2026 Oklahoma-week issue: the six live posts in the owner's reading order, plus the editorial rules prepare.py applies to each body. Nothing here is a live Wix object. Bodies come from GET /blog/v3/posts/{id}?fieldsets=URL&fieldsets=RICH_CONTENT (published version only), normalized by magazine/normalize_wix_post.py. Every rule below is reported in receipt.json. Wording is never rewritten: rules only drop web furniture, empty paragraphs and link-only text, move a credit into a caption, split a paragraph at a literal newline, or pair a mismatched quote mark. Global rules (all posts): empty paragraphs are dropped and leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; both are counted per post in receipt.json.
